user.title: Connect SweTrack
user.description: Create an API key in the SweTrack app under Profile → API (switch API on, reveal the key and copy it).

reauth_confirm.title: New SweTrack API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key no longer works. Refreshing the key in the SweTrack app invalidates the old one. Enter the current key.

error.invalid_auth: SweTrack did not accept the API key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SweTrack. Try again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This SweTrack account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That key belongs to a different SweTrack account.

data_description.scan_interval: SweTrack allows about 1000 API calls per day. 120 s uses 720 of them, 90 s uses 960.
